pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/port.ts:35 The Board's seam is switched by a hard-coded constant, so the 374-line fixture adapter (plus 392 lines of fixtureData) is never substituted at by any route, test or kit specimen (the only import of fixtureBoard is this file). It is a decorative seam that repeats the kernel's decision rules and has no contract suite holding it to them.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/port.ts:35 A dispatcher with no decision: the selection is a constant. A repo-wide grep finds fixtureBoard imported only by port.ts, and fixture.ts:18-19 itself says 'this whole side is unreached'. The rule is substitute at the seam or stop paying for it. (The real side's Deps seam is substituted, in tests/next-server/board-real.test.ts.)

app/(studio)/board/_port/fixture.ts:6 Information leakage: the stale base, undo inverse, EXISTS guard, commit refusal and token rules are encoded a second time in a file nothing runs, so one decision now lives in two modules that can drift.
app/(studio)/board/_port/actions.ts:4 Every Board verb runs one action core: who acts, the zod door, the body, then the envelope. A change to auth or validation lands in one place.
app/(studio)/board/_board/load.ts:41 Every step is effectful and the order is the job, so the load is a plain sequence with its ordering constraint stated. This is the technique's own inversion case.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: packages/kernel/src/lease-core.ts:4 The lease, queue-pick and job-outcome decisions are pure functions over snapshots and an instant (lease-core, job-queue-core, job-core). One driver each applies the writes through an Effects port, which crash.ts and the dry-run wrapper substitute at. So the decisions are testable without doubles and crash points can be enumerated.

techniques.evidence: packages/kernel/src/lease-core.ts:4 A transition function: inputs and outputs are values, time is a parameter (expired(heartbeatAt, ttlS, nowMs)), and the returned Write[] is applied by the lease.ts driver.

packages/kernel/src/effects.ts:24 Single-door Effects port with real substitutes: crash.ts instrument() wraps it for crash-prefix enumeration, and dryrun wraps it so no driver can forget dry mode. lease-core.ts:6-8 also holds the TS and Python lease implementations to one spec table.

packages/kernel/src/effects.ts:7 Three verbs (tx, blob, call) carry every driver's effects, which makes for a deep port. Queue position is computed rather than stored, so callers cannot hold a stale one.
packages/kernel/src/process.ts:13 The store handle was moved into the kernel specifically so that 'where the store lives' is encoded once, not in a second accessor.
packages/kernel/src/effects.ts:22 Transaction bodies are typed non-async and the cores are synchronous. Concurrency (several drives in flight) lives only in the job-worker driver loop.
packages/kernel/src/job-queue-core.ts:73 pickWork fills two outputs (picks, orphans) in one pass. Condition 1 holds, so explicit sequential code is the right form here.
packages/kernel/src/lease-core.ts:65 The core's input is an ordinary constructible value, not a host-minted type, so no mirror is needed.

packages/kernel/src/job-worker.ts:170 Parallel drives share one in-process closure and one runOpts object. No state is copied across a lane boundary, and the reports accumulator is a loop-scoped sink.

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: lib/library/project.ts:98 keepSet makes the prune's keep-set answer held prefixes by subclassing Set and overriding only has(). The size, iteration, forEach and set-algebra readers forwarded through ReadonlySet still describe the narrower set. The 'held prefixes are kept' invariant therefore holds only while pruneFeed (in another package) happens to call nothing but has().

techniques.evidence: lib/library/project.ts:98 Implicit delegation on a wrapper whose job is a distinction. The guard lives in one method and the rest of Set's reader surface is forwarded, so the invariant has become caller discipline. A predicate (id) => boolean would forward nothing.
lib/library/media.ts:4 Information leakage, declared in the code itself: the blob route's address format is hand-encoded here and in lib/parts/gates.ts:59, two encodings of one decision.
lib/library/feeds/types.ts:39 One small Feed interface with 16 adapters. syncLibrary takes the feeds as a parameter, and tests/next-server/library-sync.test.ts drives it.
lib/library/feeds/studio.ts:36 One pass fills items and skipped and awaits a file stat per record (conditions 1 and 2), so the explicit loop is the right form.
lib/library/project.ts:134 The fan-out over feeds lives in the one sync driver. Each feed is a single async read that imposes no flow-control model.
lib/library/fresh.ts:25 Adding a source is one feed file plus one line in LIBRARY_FEEDS, so this change class stays local.
